plan.name: Systematic Cabinet Search First
plan.strategy: Prioritize searching all cabinets in order from 1 to 6, as plates are commonly stored in cabinets. Once a clean plate is found, place it on the countertop.
steps: Check cabinet 1 for a clean plate.
If not found, proceed to check cabinet 2.
Continue this process sequentially up to cabinet 6.
If a clean plate is found, place it on the countertop.
If no clean plate is found in any cabinet, proceed to check other locations such as drawers or shelves.
